environment.scope: Headless Linux Chromium; viewport emulation does not certify real devices or other browser products.

outcomes.title: EPUB text reader sanitizes local chapters, navigates and disposes on source changes
EPUB reflows during live resizing without scroll and stays within the reader
EPUB preserves local formatting by default and keeps mode anchors and side controls
EPUB nav contents and typography work in both modes without replacing the frame
EPUB ncx contents and typography work in both modes without replacing the frame
EPUB retains a character inside a long paragraph through typography, panels, resize and modes
EPUB progress, settings and bookmarks survive reload/reselection and isolate changed content
EPUB 2.0 RTL tables and layouts stay bounded in both modes
EPUB 3.0 RTL tables and layouts stay bounded in both modes
EPUB storage failure and unsupported books recover without remote access
home and app respond in both themes without overflow
empty reader survives sidebar collapse and source actions remain available
keyboard entry, sidebar focus restoration, theme persistence and browser history work
browser library builds a tree, refreshes live handles and keeps file fallback flat
PDF reader renders local pages, text layer, navigation and malformed-file recovery
PDF search, keyboard utilities and fullscreen work on a real text PDF
app bounds and library/PDF scrolling stay independent at short heights
compact library menu dismisses independently and restores panel focus
library width resizes within bounds and top opener preserves title space
PDF geometry and canvas stay stable after large scroll jumps and panel resize
zoom and fit preserve the current reading point and zoom advances from fit
scrollbar jumps update the page field and navigation starts from the visible page
a 1,001-page PDF opens without all-page rendering and supports a distant jump
library labels use embedded title or filename and the opener tooltip stays onscreen
library and document loaders are centered, responsive and respect reduced motion
reader polish keeps tabs distinct, focus clear and motion accessible in both themes
search excerpts wrap and selected PDF occurrences stay aligned after zoom and fit
PDF reading positions survive reload and rename without matching changed content
cached workspace preserves tree, selection and panel context without retaining PDF bytes
native persisted directory reopens the PDF at its anchor and rejects changed content
PDF bookmarks retain named anchors across reload and rename and isolate changed files
library filtering and recent PDF recovery preserve document metadata
